decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8957. Series context: trend strength 0.5471 and seasonal strength 0.9917; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.177); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.823.
